description: For a complete consistent set \(S\), a sentence \(\theta\) is derivable from \(S\) if and only if \(\theta\in S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.derives_iff_mem.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)}
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S) (A : L.Formula ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives S A ↔ A ∈ S
